commit.message:
feat: comprehensive copilot-sdk skill with full API coverage

Significantly expanded the copilot-sdk skill from ~510 to ~900 lines:

- Architecture section with transport modes (stdio/TCP)
- Expanded hooks: all 6 hooks with input/output fields, examples in
  multiple languages (pre/post tool use, user prompt, session lifecycle,
  error handling)
- Comprehensive BYOK section: all provider configs (OpenAI, Azure,
  Anthropic, Ollama), provider config reference table, Azure Managed
  Identity pattern, limitations
- Full authentication coverage: priority order, OAuth GitHub App,
  supported token types, disable auto-login
- Session persistence: resume options, session ID best practices,
  what gets persisted, infinite sessions
- MCP server integration: local + HTTP configs with all fields,
  debugging tips, MCP Inspector usage
- Deployment patterns: local CLI, external server, bundled CLI,
  Docker Compose, session isolation patterns, production checklist
- Permission & input handlers with deny-by-default model
- SDK vs CLI feature comparison with workarounds
- Expanded debugging: common issues table, connection state
- Skills integration with combined examples

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
